This is a reasonable implementation that matches the reference in the main email/wildcard and no-site cases, and it skips names that already have a site policy. It diverges in ways that likely break the hidden adapt golden test. It always builds a base policy (always=true), so a subject-only policy can appear where the reference emits none. Non-shared internal policies may reorder or merge differently from the shared internalAP. It also lowercases names and hard-errors on non-qualifying names, neither of which the spec asks for. The tests are thoughtful, including a dummy-site equivalence check and four adapt fixtures, but some expected outputs may not match the code's empty-policy behavior.

This closely follows the existing site-block logic and covers the listed requirements: appended parsing, the no-sites case, matching the dummy site block, internal issuer for localhost/IPs, site-block-wins and auto_https off. However, building the base policy with always=true can leave empty subject-only policies in some outputs where the reference emits none. The unrequested lowercasing and erroring on non-qualifying names are further divergences, and either could explain the failed hidden test.
